summary: Most of the frustration centres on positive user experience, followed by storage limit and pricing concerns and security and privacy concerns. Users are frustrated with storage limits, account disablements, and pricing models that charge for storage and access to personal files without clear justification or notice.

themes.name: Security and Privacy Concerns
themes.description: Users are worried about data security, account access, and Dropbox's scanning of user content for third-party analysis.
themes.recommendation: Enhance security transparency and user control over data.

themes.recommendation: Improve app reliability, login flow, and sync accuracy.

themes.name: User Experience and Accessibility
themes.description: Users find the app frustrating to use, especially on mobile, with excessive verification steps and limited camera functionality.
themes.recommendation: Simplify login and verification processes, and improve mobile camera support.
